changelog.entry: Wetland Forest: a third region unlocked at 5000 standing forest value. It grows 25% faster than the main forest, but a flood sweeps it every 50 ticks — young plots lose 30% of their value, mature ones 10%, replanting plots get silted back — with a 10-tick warning so you can harvest ahead of the water (B1).
Example playthrough: a narrated, worked-out example of a strong preserve/clear balance, with every number calculated from the game's own settings (B29).
Achievement cards now show "Earned by N% of players" once enough real save data exists for that achievement (site-wide goal, Z1/Z27b).
Added a keyboard-shortcuts help overlay: press ? to see it, Esc to close it or whichever panel is open (site-wide goal, Z4).
Settings panel: added a "Reset to Default" button that resets text size and reduce-motion back to their defaults in one click (site-wide goal, folded from A26).

Session Summary is now print-friendly: printing the page (e.g. Ctrl/Cmd+P) while it's open hides the site chrome and renders the summary in clean dark-on-white, instead of the site's usual dark theme and UI.
Highland Grove now has its own distinct rates: soil degrades 50% faster per clear and standing value compounds 25% slower than the main forest, reflecting a harsher high-altitude ecosystem.

Round-2 pass, remaining items: reforestation partner (faster replant recovery for a permanent value share), a legacy forest bonus carried into the next session from the last one's standing value, a seasonal growth cycle, and the shared personal-best badge flash (also rolled out to Tide and Thaw).

Round-2 pass: Small 4x4 grid, Forest ranger difficulty, forest history + wildlife log, playstyle badge, report-card graphs, veteran and adopted plots, specialist plots, replanting grants, Highland unlock progress bar, biodiversity rate, and an opt-in community comparison.
Onboarding-tooltip coverage audit completed — legend and stakeholder info-icons plus per-plot tooltips already cover every non-obvious mechanic, no gap found.
Settings panel added: text size (A-/A/A+) and a reduce-motion toggle, both persisted per-browser.
Space theme visual pass: starfield background, glass panels, gradient buttons, gradient-glow title.
Code-quality audit: fixed a create_proxy memory leak in the plot-grid render loop and a stale stakeholder-request bug that could hand out a free relations bonus.
Pass 3 (fun/teaching balance): re-paced stakeholder tension and the biodiversity payoff closer together to close an early idle stretch.
Info Page added with curated real-world sources on deforestation and carbon sinks.
Pass 2: biodiversity sub-meter (wildlife icons on mature plots) and stakeholder-tension decision events.
Pass 1: continuous plot-maturity color gradient, recovery-milestone flash, and a real-world context blurb.
All 7 milestones complete: plot grid, passive value accrual, clearing + soil degradation, replant recovery, comparison scoring, feedback prompt, visual pass + hub integration.
